dct_description_sm: Pictorial vignettes of settlements, sea creatures.
From Bünting's Itinerarium sacrae scripturae, Helmstadt: Jacobus Lucius, 1582.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 426.
"24" on verso, and gothic German text: Folger nun die Beschreibung des heiligen Landes ...
